chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to us, saying: My father reported to me, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdillah reported to us, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both.

He said: On the Day of Resurrection, a caller will call from the interior of the Throne: 'Where is the khalifa of Allah on His earth?' So Dawud the Prophet, peace be upon him, will stand up. Then the announcement will come from Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'We do not intend you, although you were a khalifa for Allah.' Then a second call will be made: 'Where is the khalifa of Allah on His earth?' Then the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, will stand. And the announcement will come from Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'O assembly of creatures! This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, the khalifa of Allah on His earth and His proof over His servants. So whoever held fast to his rope in the abode of this world, let him hold fast to his rope on this Day, that he may seek light from his light, and let him follow him to the highest ranks of the Gardens.'

He said: Then a group of people will stand who had held fast to his rope in this world, and they will follow him into Paradise. Then the announcement will come from Allah, Most Glorified be His Majesty: 'Indeed, whoever followed an imam in the abode of this world, let him follow him to wherever he goes with him.'

Then at that time 'those who were followed will disown those who followed them, and they will see the punishment, and all ties between them will be severed. And those who followed will say: If only we had one more chance, we would disown them as they have disowned us. Thus will Allah show them their deeds as regrets upon them, and they will never come out of the Fire.' (Quran 2:166-167)

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Amali al-Mufid say about Imam Ali being Allah's khalifa on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describes a scene on the Day of Resurrection in which a caller from within the Throne asks for Allah's khalifa on earth. Prophet Dawud (AS) stands but is told he is not the one intended. Then Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) is proclaimed as Allah's true khalifa, His proof over His servants. Those who adhered to Ali's rope in this world will follow him into the highest ranks of Paradise, while those who followed false leaders will face the fate described in Quran 2:166-167 -- the leaders will disown their followers, all bonds will be severed, and they will never escape the Fire. This hadith was narrated by Shaykh al-Saduq in the circle of al-Mufid's teaching sessions in Baghdad, addressing the theological question of legitimate authority (wilayah) after the Prophet (S).
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibnAli ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from his father, who reported from Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan Ibn Yahya, from Aban ibn Uthman, who reported that: Abu Abdullah, Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, said:

On the Day of Resurrection, an announcer will announce from inside the Throne: "Where is the Khalifa of Allah on earth?" So Dawood, the Prophet, will stand up and the voice from Allah, Most High, will say: "We do not mean you, although you were Allah’s Khalifa." Then a second announcement will be made: "Where is Allah’s Khalifa on earth?" Then Amirul Mu’mineen, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, will rise. So a voice will come from Allah, Most High: "O people! This ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib is the khalifa of Allah on His earth and His proof over His slaves. So whoever adhered to his rope while on earth, should hang on to his rope here (also), so that he may have the benefit of his light and may follow him in the rising ranks of Paradise."

He said: A group of people will rise who had adhered to his rope during life on earth, and will follow him into Paradise. Then there will be announcement from Allah, Most High: "O those who followed a leader while living on earth, follow him as he goes, and they will go with him."

That will be the time when those who led will dissociate themselves from those who followed them, and they will see the chastisement, and all relations between them will be severed. ’And those who followed will say: if only we had one more chance, we would dissociate ourselves from them, as they have disowned themselves from us. Thus will Allah show them their deeds as anguish for them and never will they come out of the hellfire.’ (2:166,167).
